name: Mahou de Onna no Ko ni Henshin! Omou Mama ni Ecchi na Koto o Shichau Ore!
original_name: 魔法で女の子に変身ッ！ 思うままにエッチなことをしちゃう俺！
source:
A magical curse transforms the protagonist into a cute DD-cups little girl!?

A dream-cum-true adventure!!

When Soara, masturbation addict, heard about an ecchi school myth that would heighten his personal time he investigated with an eager hand. He traced the myth to a magic spellbook in the library, and in a brilliant beam of light his body was changed!

assaulted by a stranger. More (trans)sexual situations than he ever expected!
